quote: corporate bond documents, and disclosures
relevance: Bond Central's stated scope overlaps with document access, so this project does not build a listing portal.

quote: information repository for the public at large
relevance: Bond Central's stated purpose, as announced by SEBI. The portal itself could not be reached for review.

quote: Providing copy of debenture trust deed to investor
relevance: The investor charter's route to a trust deed runs through the trustee, for investors.

quote: Guidance note on list of Covenants
relevance: Source of the covenant categories used in the dataset (Annex-VIA).

quote: disclosed all covenants proposed to be included in debenture
relevance: Trustee due diligence covers disclosure of covenants in the offer document, which makes offer documents a route to the terms.

quote: the Press Release shall also contain a detailed explanation of all the covenants of the security
relevance: Rating press releases must explain all covenants for credit-enhanced ratings (paragraph 14.3). The master circular sets no such general rule for other ratings.

quote: the CRA shall include all the assumptions/ covenants made while carrying out the review of such products in the Press Release
relevance: For structured finance products, press releases must include the covenants assumed (paragraph 10.1.10).

quote: shall be reckoned at the ISIN level
relevance: Why the dataset is keyed on the ISIN rather than the issuer.

quote: Expert Working group
relevance: SEBI is reviewing the trustee framework, so the rules this dataset is built around may change.

quote: Such suggestions may be submitted in the format prescribed below on or before July 15, 2026
relevance: The public comment window of SEBI's review of the trustee framework closed on 15 July 2026.

quote: Inspect debenture trust deed, to obtain copy
relevance: The right to a copy is framed as an investor's right.

quote: a single ISIN which may have been split across multiple offer documents
relevance: Why instruments and documents are linked many-to-many.

quote: compliance status with respect to financial covenants of the listed debt securities which shall be certified by the statutory auditor
relevance: Issuers must give trustees an auditor-certified statement of financial covenant compliance every quarter.

quote: including compliance with all the covenants, in respect of listed non
relevance: Regulation 56(1)(d) requires a statutory auditor's certificate that covers compliance with all the covenants.

quote: shall not make material modification without prior approval of the stock exchange(s)
relevance: Regulation 59(1). Changes to the terms of listed debentures need the exchange's prior approval.

quote: holders of not less than three -fourths, by value of holders of that class of securities
relevance: Regulation 59(2). The exchange approves only after the board, the trustee and three-fourths of holders by value.

quote: disclose the security cover available in case of non - convertible debt securities along with its financial results
relevance: Regulation 54(3) of the LODR Regulations, the basis of the issuers' quarterly security cover filings.

quote: all information and reports including compliance reports filed by the listed entity
relevance: Regulation 62(1)(g). Issuers' websites must carry the compliance reports they file, including covenant statements.

quote: Any breach of the minimum security cover within two working days
relevance: A separate disclosure to the exchange, which this dataset has not collected.

quote: upto April 27, 2027
relevance: This circular extends a deadline on trustees' non-SEBI business and does not change covenant monitoring.

quote: enter the covenants of the issuance in the system and upload the debenture trust deed
relevance: Covenants and trust deeds are held in that system, which is why an independent public record has to be rebuilt from other sources.

quote: Provide secure login credentials to Issuers, CRAs, Debenture Trustees
relevance: The Security and Covenant Monitoring System is a credentialed stakeholder platform.

quote: breached during the quarter
relevance: The prescribed column heading ties a listing to breaches during the quarter, which some rows carry over.

quote: Status of information regarding breach of covenants/ terms of the issue, if any action taken by Debenture Trustee
relevance: The prescribed format of the trustee reports (Annex-VIIA, Table 5).

quote: Independently monitor any breach of covenants
relevance: Trustees are themselves expected to monitor public disclosures.

quote: Furnish a status report on its website and to the Stock Exchange
relevance: Basis of the quarterly trustee reports this dataset transcribes.

quote: Hyperlink of the press releases by the Credit rating Agency
relevance: Trustees' rating-revision table links each ISIN to the rating agency's press release (Annex-VIIA, Table 1).

quote: Quarterly compliance report of the
relevance: Trustees publish, per listed entity and ISIN, whether quarterly compliance reports and security cover certificates were received (Annex-VIIA, Table 3), which makes a per-trustee census of monitored issues possible.
